a.xlink:title: The button that adds an incident was clicked.
Shows the form of a connection of the run, with the positions of its nodes in metres.
Shows the form of a node of the run, with its coordinates in metres.
Hides the dock and shows the information of the passenger on the canvas instead.
Shows the form of a signal of the run, with its position and the length of the section ahead in metre...
Shows the form of a station node of the run and selects its station.
Shows the train and follows it.
Does what handleCloseInfoDockWidget does and hides the dock.
The state of the track during a run.
The value in fixed notation with precision digits after the decimal point.
The one section with this runtime id; null when none or several have it.
A chainage in kilometres as printf "%f" writes it, the form used in switch section ids.
The positions of the sections with this runtime id, in order; null when there is none.
The aspect code of the head.
The state of a signal head for an aspect code, as SignalCueKind lists it.
Shows the train and, when changeFollowMode is set, follows it.
